name: Write-only script properties
description: Flags Property declarations that are assigned in this script but whose value is never read.
definition: Flags `Property` declarations that are written (`name = ...` or a compound `name += ...`) somewhere in this script but never read. A name that is never referenced at all is left to `unused-property`. A `; @external` annotation on the declaration line opts the property out, for values consumed by the editor, MCM, or another script.
